rules.statement: A same-Sequence Beyonder characteristic can stand in for the main materials of that Sequence's potion; the supplementary items are still needed and Sequences cannot be skipped. Beyonder characteristics are conserved, so a creature part that carries the characteristic and a dead Beyonder's characteristic are the same stuff.
rules.speaker: character (stated in scene, per the table's T tags)
rules.mechanism: brew_law main slot as an unnamed lot (src/lotm_derived_formulas.js, src/world_packs/lotm_brew_pack.js packRow)

rules.statement: A pathway has one Sequence 0 at a time and it needs the Uniqueness; the Sequence 0 potions the novel states combine the Uniqueness with Sequence 1 characteristics. The Sequence 0 branch is fitted to two stated rows (Fool, Black Emperor), so it is a default and outside the score.
